title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: add canonical RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples to make it easier for engineers to get started with agents and tool calls on Redwood. This PR adds opinionated quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), a set of small agent templates (basic retrieval agent, multi-tool agent), and docs site pages with step-by-step instructions and copy/paste snippets.

What this PR does (high level):
- docs/rag/quickstarts: two new quickstart pages (agent-basic, tool-calling) with step-by-step commands, expected outputs, and troubleshooting tips.
- redwood-examples/rag/agent-templates: Python agent templates (basic retrieval, tool-calling agent) and a TypeScript example showing function/tool calling + streaming.
- docs site updates: sidebar entries, cross-links to SDK examples, and a small how-to for pinning model versions in dedicated/private deployments.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add quickstart docs and sidebar entries
- [x] Add Python example agent with README and tests
- [x] Add TypeScript tool-calling example and tsconfig adjustments
- [x] Lint and spellcheck docs
- [x] CI: docs preview and examples integration tests pass

Testing notes:
- Ran docs preview locally (mkdocs) and verified new pages render and sidebar order is correct.
- Executed Python example against local redwood-dev with mocked retrieval layer; included a small smoke test in examples/tests/test_basic_agent.py.
- Ran TypeScript example (node 18) and verified the tool call flow using the dev server simulator.

How to review: focus on docs wording and the Python/TS example READMEs for clarity. Code changes are intentionally small and isolated to examples and docs. Related: ENG-4521 for product requirements and DOCS-99 for editorial review.
